types.name: Temperature_t
types.description: A temperature as the sensors report it

types.name: Sample_t
types.description: One reading and the instant it was taken

members.name: value
members.description: The reading itself

members.name: timestamp
members.description: Milliseconds since the last reset

types.name: Cell_t
types.description: One cell of a grid: two flags between two values

members.name: raw
members.description: The cell's raw reading

members.name: valid
members.description: Set once the reading is trusted

members.name: bias
members.description: A signed correction, in counts

members.name: v
members.description: The corrected reading, after the flags

types.name: Sensor_t
types.description: A sensor: a nested structure, an array of values and an array of structures

members.name: latest
members.description: The most recent reading

members.name: history
members.description: The last four readings, oldest first

members.name: cells
members.description: The sensor's two cells

members.name: state
members.description: The sensor's state machine

types.name: Status_t
types.description: Bitfields in units of one, two and four bytes, each group followed by a value

members.name: ready
members.description: Bit 0 of a byte

members.name: trim
members.description: Four signed bits after it

members.name: mode
members.description: Five bits, which would cross the byte and so start the next one

members.name: level
members.description: A byte after the byte bitfields

members.name: count
members.description: Nine bits, which would cross a two byte unit after level

members.name: delta
members.description: Seven signed bits after them

members.name: word
members.description: Two bytes after the two byte bitfields

members.name: wide
members.description: Twenty bits of a four byte unit

members.name: drift
members.description: Twelve signed bits filling it

members.name: tail
members.description: A byte after the four byte bitfields

types.name: Mixed_t
types.description: Values inside a bitfield's unit, and bitfields of an eight byte unit

members.name: flags
members.description: Three bits of a four byte unit

members.name: after
members.description: A byte right after the three bits, inside their unit

members.name: next
members.description: Two bytes after it, still inside the unit

members.name: big
members.description: Forty bits, which would cross an eight byte unit after next

members.name: small
members.description: Seven signed bits after them

members.name: last
members.description: Four bytes after the eight byte bitfields

types.name: Tuning_t
types.description: What the calibration tool may change: values around two bitfields

members.name: gain
members.description: The loop gain

members.name: shift
members.description: A signed offset, in counts

members.name: enable
members.description: Whether the loop runs

members.name: retries
members.description: How many times a failed step is tried again

members.name: timeout
members.description: Milliseconds before a step fails, after the bitfields
